description: This file contains benchmark classes for testing DTensor operations in PyTorch, including setup, various operation benchmarks, and a main function to run and collect results.

classes.name: BenchmarkDTensorDispatch
classes.description: Base class for benchmarking DTensor dispatch operations, initializing device mesh and DTensors.

classes.name: BenchmarkDetach
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing detach operation on DTensor.

classes.name: BenchmarkToFromLocal
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing conversion to and from local tensor.

classes.name: BenchmarkCollectives
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing collective operations like redistribute, alltoall, allgather, etc.

classes.name: BenchmarkAddBackward
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing backward pass with addition on DTensors.

classes.name: BenchmarkInplace
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing in-place addition on DTensors.

classes.name: BenchmarkView
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing view operation on DTensor.

classes.name: BenchmarkRandom
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing random tensor operations.

classes.name: BenchmarkCustomHandler
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing custom handler operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to initialize process group, run various benchmarks, and collect results.
